name: bmon 5.0
body:
## What's Changed
### Fixes
* out_curses: use xcalloc instead of a fixed buffer by @NachiP in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/54
* Avoid trying to include <values.h> on Android by @fornwall in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/55
* Fix typographical errors by @afh in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/63
* curses: Fix seperator lines by @afh in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/64
* Fix build in FreeBSD/DragonflyBSD by @farrokhi in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/76
* fix segfault on element removal by @dcaratti in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/102
* fix: Fix memory leaks in module_set() by @csiltala in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/122
* fix: Convert usage of strdup/free to xstrdup/xfree by @csiltala in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/124
* Fix compile issue in OpenBSD by @FlyingHacker in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/92
* Fix spelling and grammar in docs and comments by @Jafaral in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/125
### Features
* Allow numeric colors in bmonrc by @afh in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/62
* curses: Add CTRL-N/CTRL-P for next/previous element by @afh in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/65
* feat: Add IPv4/IPv6 addresses to additional info by @csiltala in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/117
* feat: Add configure option to disable IPv6 in netlink module by @csiltala in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/121
* feat: Add ability to toggle TC elements by @csiltala in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/120
* curses: render graphs with Braille cells by @crgr in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/114
* display filters for TC ingress and egress by @dcaratti in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/100
* Add support for JSON output by @Jafaral in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/126
* Remove the 'Really quit' dialog and just exit cleanly by @graysky2 in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/113
### Misc
* Add package installation instructions for Fedora/CentOS by @carlwgeorge in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/78
* Update to autoconf of the common era by @Jafaral in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/116
* ci: add GitHub Actions builds for Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD by @Jafaral in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/118
* ci: enable -Werror for compiler warnings by @Jafaral in https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/pull/119

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Jafaral/bmon/compare/v4.0...v5.0
